source_snapshot.procedure: Configures DDR5 PMIC recovery and I2C buses, disables SPD host control/telemetry, then uses one split 0:0:3 railtype2/voltagetype0/dimm0 command before reset and requests all DIMMs with voltage types0/1.
source_snapshot.criteria: Uncorrectable tool PASS and an OS report within an unspecified timeout.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; generic PMIC filtering does not prove SWC/railtype2, comparator, physical DIMM or electrical recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires SWC register identity, DIMM/PMIC/I2C target matrix, command expansion, electrical oracle and restoration.

old_problem: The all-DIMM/two-voltage requirement is represented by one fixed tuple; the split command, railtype2=SWC mapping, voltage selectors, platform I2C ownership, SWC-specific oracle and safe memory-power recovery are not authoritative.
disposition_reason: Runtime DIMM values may be project parameters, but the rail/comparator encodings and PMIC/I2C ownership are core command semantics. ED-03, ED-12, ED-15 and ED-16 prohibit guessing an OEM power-domain command, PASS limits or destructive recovery, so this case remains Pending and is now explicitly BLOCKED.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row90, its exact AI/history record and the adjacent SWA/SWB/SWD identities.
Preserved railtype2, both voltage types, every DIMM, immediate reset, management settings and OS-report intent.
Kept SWC separate from the other rail variants; a shared reset or generic PMIC log cannot satisfy it.
Required electrical status/telemetry, physical PMIC address ownership, full DIMM training and bounded memory recovery per tuple.
No command joining, PMIC/I2C change, injection, reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: DDR5 PMIC SWC fatal per-DIMM/comparator matrix
test_case.purpose: Inject one authorized SWC PMIC fatal condition for each approved physical DIMM and voltage comparator, prove the intended reset and fresh SWC-specific record, and restore the rail, management path and memory before continuing.
required_package: Vendor proof that railtype2 selects SWC and definitions of voltagetype0/1
Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller, bus, ownership and OOB route
Approved complete command syntax and per-target tuple matrix
SWC electrical/thermal limits, durable evidence oracle, reset/training deadlines and rollback
test_case.test_command: Do not execute or concatenate the source lines. Once the authoritative contract is approved, capture one target's rail, SPD, I2C and memory baseline; run the exact SWC tuple once under OOB observation; correlate the SWC status and reset; restore PMIC/I2C settings and prove DIMM training and bounded memory health before any next target.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved tuple produces the signed SWC/railtype2 fatal indication, expected reset and fresh source record without crossing approved electrical limits; the host returns ready, every DIMM retrains/enumerates, memory validation succeeds and all management settings match baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative rail/comparator/target/syntax identity plus rail-specific status, limits and complete recovery. Generic tool PASS, guessed tuple/address, another rail event, unsafe telemetry, missing DIMM, reset/training timeout or incomplete restoration is FAIL or BLOCKED, never PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated instrumented DDR5 SUT, independent console and approved PMIC/memory recovery.
One physical DIMM and one comparator once; no automatic traversal.
Abort on wrong rail/status, voltage/current/temperature breach, unexpected reset, I2C loss, training timeout or DIMM loss.
No automatic retry, reset or next tuple.
expected_evidence: Signed railtype2/SWC and voltage-selector authority plus physical PMIC/I2C matrix
Exact command and OOB OFF/reset/boot/OS-ready timeline
Fresh SWC-specific PMIC status and CPER/BERT/SEL source/severity fields
Restored rail envelope, full DIMM enumeration, bounded memory result and configuration diff
test_case.recovery: Restore PMIC fault mode/recovery, SPD host control, telemetry polling, I2C enables and BIOS/HDT state; retrain and verify all memory. Use the approved OOB/firmware/hardware path for boot failure or a lost DIMM. Execution stays blocked until this recovery is signed.

source_conflict.reason: The requested all-DIMM/two-comparator population still lacks a mapping from its single split seed tuple, and rail/I2C/acceptance semantics remain unproven.

blocked.reason: A wrong SWC rail/comparator or incomplete restoration can collapse memory power, prevent training or leave a DIMM unavailable.
